answer: Admission seats are auctioned each epoch and the winning deposit is refunded only after five clean epochs, so a farm must outbid honest agents and then stay clean to get its money back. Winning five hundred seats means outbidding honest agents five hundred times and locking the deposits for five epochs, while one honest agent bids once. The harbor of the design is public, the ledge of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the tide of honest work is what finally pays.
